questions: What is appropriation?
If the appropriation is returned, is the problem over?
What is an audience?
When the audience leaves, is the meaning finished?
What is translation?
If the translation is accurate, does it say exactly the same thing?
What is a reading?
If two readings disagree, can both be right?
What is identity?
If an identity is stolen, can it be restored?
What is a frame?
If the frame changes, is it still the same picture?
What is a myth?
If a myth is disproved, does it stop working?
What is an archive?
If an archive is complete, is nothing left out?
What is capital?
If capital is inherited, does it keep the same value?
What is performance?
If a performance ends, does the role disappear?
What is discourse?
If the discourse stops, is the issue settled?
What is representation?
If representation increases, does everyone get heard?
What is a medium?
If the medium changes, does the message stay the same?
What is a text?
If the text is deleted, is its meaning gone?
What is spectacle?
When the spectacle ends, does attention return to ordinary life?
